_comment: Arcade profiles as shipped. The owner changes them from their computer with make admin, which keeps its copy on the cabinet (/home/pi/.pi-arcade/profiles.json) and wins over this file; nothing at the cabinet can change them. A combo is pressed one input at a time on the sign-in screen. Inputs: up, down, left, right, 1-6 (action buttons), start. Coin is never part of a combo: it clears the entry, and Coin + anything is a RetroArch hotkey. No combo may be the start of another. limits (every profile but the owner's; see docs/arcade-profiles.md): hours by weekdays / weekends / mon..sun as "HH:MM-HH:MM"; time.minutes per "day", "week" or "N days" (with "from": "YYYY-MM-DD"), and rollover true to carry unused time into the next period.
